Alytus Jewish Сemetery 1

Jewish Cemetery · Alytaus apskritis, Lithuania

Demolished. This is one of Alytus's Jewish cemeteries, located in Alytus I, part of a Jewish community considered among the oldest in Lithuania, traceable to the 16th century. Between August 13 and September 9, 1941, following the Nazi invasion, 1,137 Jewish men, women, and children were murdered in the nearby Vidzgiris forest, alongside Jews from Czechoslovakia and tens of thousands of Soviet civilians and prisoners of war; a new memorial in the shape of a broken Star of David was erected there in 1993. This cemetery's oldest tombstone dates to 1755, and due to the hilly terrain, its graves lack a single consistent orientation.
